# Antoine Boucher

> Software engineer (Montréal): platform systems, interactive graphics, secure cloud delivery, and open source. English is the default language for international readers; French content lives under /fr/ on the blog and in parallel CV artifacts.

## Identity

- Name: Antoine Boucher
- Role: Software Engineer — Platform and graphics
- Focus: backends, Kubernetes/GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, C++/OpenGL, Blender, MCP tooling (uml-mcp)
- Proof: IMC2 secure cloud platforms; DevSecOps teaching (LOG 8100) at Polytechnique Montréal
